prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 93.4%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 89.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 74.4%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 88.0%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 69.7%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Companion Controls Tutorial Screen: Adds a dedicated interactive controls preview screen right before home launch that demonstrates how to summon, hide, and interact with the desktop pet. (why: Support receives multiple complaints about users not knowing how to control or hide pets after setup, and finish step conversion is 69.7%.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Trait Studio Adoption Redesign: Redesigns the friend picking screen into a dynamic two-column preview studio with live trait audio and personality feedback. (why: Adoption stage drops to 74.4% with high mean time (1017s); a studio layout clarifies choices and speeds decision making.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Certificate Sign-In Delay Flow: Delays sign-in until after adoption certificate completion so users fully create their pet before creating an account. (why: Creating emotional connection before authentication reduces the 74.4% drop in adoption and makes account registration feel protective.)
3: [choose_path, new_flow] Companion Path Recommendation Quiz Flow: Inserts a brief 2-question path selection quiz before the choose path screen to guide users to their ideal pet path. (why: Choose path exhibits a high mean duration (514s), signaling choice hesitation that an interactive quiz resolves.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Existing Pet Restoration Account Hint: Adds explicit reassurance text and sync status badge on sign-in confirming existing pets will be restored without data loss. (why: 8 support emails (the top complaint category) reported missing or reset pets after signing in.)
5: [finish, copy] System Tray Launch Guidance Copy: Updates home intro body text to explain tray navigation, minimizing options, and desktop pet summoning. (why: Post-onboarding confusion tickets center around pet controls and desktop visibility.)
6: [home, notification] Render Completion Audio & Banner Alert: Enables audio chime and system tray notification when rendering finishes while app is minimized. (why: Waiting step mean duration is 2336s (38 minutes), causing users to abandon or forget backgrounded progress.)

scores.note: Targets low 69.7% finish step backed by support complaints, but adding a new screen increases friction.
Addresses high 1017s mean duration at adoption stage, though requires a major studio UI redesign.
Delaying auth can boost emotional investment before sign-in, but requires significant flow changes.
Choose path already converts well at 93.4%, so adding a quiz screen offers limited upside.
Directly resolves top support complaint category with a simple, copy-based hint.
Low-cost copy update addressing post-onboarding confusion and low 69.7% finish retention.
Audio/banner alerts prevent user drop-off caused by the 2336s background render bottleneck.
